Population increased in South Hams

The estimated population of South Hams in 2024 was 92,148 usual residents, a rise of 1.3% since 2023.

This meant that South Hams' rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of South Hams increased by 3.4%.

Over this slightly longer period, South Hams was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of South Hams

The average (median) age fell to 51.3 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of South Hams has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
South Hams is an area that is classed as rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, South Hams' population of 92,148 usual residents was made up of:

  • 14,255 people aged 0 to 15 years, (15.5%)
  • 51,333 people aged 16 to 64 years, (55.7%)
  • 26,560 people aged 65 years and over, (28.8%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, South Hams has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (28.8% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In South Hams, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in South Hams
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for South Hams, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 415 people (-0.5%). In total, there were 571 births and 986 deaths in South Hams.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,420 (1.6%). There were 6,659 people entering the area and 5,239 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in South Hams' population of 176 (0.2%) as a result of 440 people entering the area and 264 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for South Hams was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of South Hams in mid-2023 is 90,937.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 135 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 40 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 95 people.
